honest_statement: The maximum achievable viability is not ~100%. Under the per-object cost criterion and worst-case solar activity it peaks near 67% at 1 cm, 900 km. Under the plan's per-kilogram cost criterion it is essentially zero for centimetre debris at every altitude, because the target masses grams. The residual gap to 100% is dominated by two quantities that are programmatic rather than physical -- how many objects one platform can service, and what the platform costs -- not by the kick physics, which clears its gates comfortably.
